standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the relation satisfied by the classes obtained by capping with the Chern classes of the pulled back sheaf, and then the uniqueness that identifies the pushed forward classes as the Chern classes of the sheaf on the target.

standard_prerequisites.name: Compatibility of the cap with a first Chern class and flat pullback, with proper pushforward, and preservation of rational equivalence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, labels lemma-pushforward-cap-c1 (proof line 7428), lemma-flat-pullback-proper-pushforward (proof line 7429) and lemma-proper-pushforward-rational-equivalence (proof line 7426)
standard_prerequisites.use: They let the relation be pushed forward along the morphism between the projective bundles and rewritten in terms of the pushed forward classes, which is where the projection formula is used.

core_obligations: Set up the relation: let P be the projective bundle of the sheaf on the target, note that its base change is the projective bundle of the pulled back sheaf with the twisting sheaf pulled back, write the classes obtained by capping with the Chern classes of the pulled back sheaf, and record the characterising relation on the base changed bundle (proof lines 7407-7417).

Push the relation forward: apply the proper pushforward along the morphism between the projective bundles to the relation, using compatibility of the cap with a first Chern class and with flat pullback to rewrite the result as the same relation for the pushed forward classes on the projective bundle of the target (proof lines 7418-7434).

Conclude by uniqueness: the characterisation of the Chern classes on a projective bundle identifies the pushed forward classes with the caps of the Chern classes of the sheaf on the target, which is the assertion (proof lines 7435-7436).
proof_roadmap: Write the characterising relation on the base changed bundle (proof lines 7407-7417).
Push it forward and rewrite using the cap compatibilities (proof lines 7418-7434).
Identify the result by uniqueness (proof lines 7435-7436).
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the projection formula for an arbitrary Chern class against a proper pushforward (statement lines 7393-7405, tag 02SJ). The proof is a real argument through projective bundles: it records the characterising relation for the classes obtained by capping with the Chern classes of the pulled back sheaf on the projective bundle of the sheaf, pushes that relation forward along the morphism between the projective bundles using compatibility of the cap with a first Chern class, with flat pullback and with proper pushforward, and then identifies the pushed forward classes by the uniqueness part of the characterisation. The pushforward of the relation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
